article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Tyler Mrus’ 27 points helped Citadel defeat Erskine 100-57 on Friday. Mrus had five rebounds for the Bulldogs (1-1). Aaron Ekwere scored 14 points and added seven rebounds. Keynan Davis went 5 of 10 from the field (2 for 6 from 3-point range) to finish with 14 points, while adding six rebounds. Justen Goudelock led the way for the Flying Fleet with 16 points. Erskine also got nine points from Max Peeler. Evan Carter finished with nine points. Up next Citadel’s next game is Tuesday against Virginia-Lynchburg at home. Erskine visits Gardner-Webb on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
